title: Nuclear Dimension after Jiang–Su Stabilization
exact_target: Is $\operatorname{dim}_{\mathrm{nuc}}(A\otimes\mathcal Z)<\infty$ for every nuclear $C^*$-algebra $A$? What is the decomposition rank of $C(X)\subset C(X,M_n)$? Is it less than $\dim X$, or does dimension drop only after tensoring with a UHF algebra?
